raw_metadata.logical_source: Amazon Reviews'23 Grocery and Gourmet Food metadata

primary_image_definition.statement: PRIMARY IMAGE = frozen metadata snapshot + same parent_asin source record + source-declared MAIN variant

source_record_hash_definition: SHA-256 of the exact uncompressed UTF-8 JSON line bytes with terminal CR/LF removed only; parsing and re-serialization is forbidden because it changes bytes
label_blindness_rules: P7-A code and formal run must not read frozen 39, 39b, V2.1 product labels, P5/R2 adjudication, A1/A2 annotations, review text, review-derived label columns, or G exposure outputs
all source/image-role judgments derive only from 01_valid_products.csv and the frozen raw metadata source
no label-driven image selection logic is permitted in the P7-A code path or Git-visible PR
parent_child_rules: P7-A does not use child images
image_role = child_variant_proxy may only enter a secondary/sensitivity layer, never primary
without a deterministic parent-child mapping, child images must not be merged into primary
fallback_separation_rules: first-image fallback (no usable MAIN candidate) is not primary
existing_first_image_fallback is recorded distinctly from declared_main
selection_fallback_used=true only when no usable MAIN candidate exists and the historical logic selects the first usable image
